Deck Studio
Source → Shape → Deck

What are we presenting?

Write or paste your brief in the box at the bottom. Plain text is fine. The first line becomes the title, a short line with nothing after it becomes a section heading, the sentences under it become the argument and the lines that are not sentences become the list. Nothing is invented: a field the brief cannot feed stays a visible bracketed gap.

Shape

The order is the opinion. The same brief told as a pitch and told as a readout is not the same deck: the pitch puts the problem before the number, the readout puts the number first because the number already happened.

Deck

Every slide, at its own size, with its own fields beside it. Type and the slide re-renders. Anything still in square brackets is a gap the brief did not fill — it is marked on the slide, and it stays marked until you write it.

Write your brief, then press Send
Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · layouts from deck-layouts.js

Start from a campaign

Every set built in Concept Studio in this browser, newest first. Deck Studio only reads this list — nothing here is changed, removed or written back. Picking one tells it as a campaign deck: the concept up front, the work, where it runs, and the concept's own stated risk on a slide of its own.

Deck history

Everything saved in this browser. The deck model is kept, never the built file: a rendered deck with its fonts and pictures inlined would not fit in localStorage, and the model rebuilds it byte for byte.
